_about: What the car gains as you survive. `start` is the car's own, told when you first get in. At each time in `at` (seconds since the pursuer stood up) the core draws one of `pool` at random that the car does not have yet; entries that share an `id` (the turbos) come in the order listed. `id` is the rule in crates/core/src/car.rs (Kit) it switches on; `name` and `text` are what the player reads when it arrives.

start.name: Roll over
start.text: Hold R to roll the car back onto its wheels.

pool.name: Big wheels
pool.text: Q: eight seconds on wheels tall enough to drive over a fallen building.

pool.name: Wings
pool.text: F: fly for 5 seconds. W dives, S climbs, A and D bank.

pool.name: Dash
pool.text: C: a kick toward whichever way W A S D point. Works in the air.

pool.name: Instant turn
pool.text: X: swing straight round, speed and all. Hold A or D for a quarter turn.

pool.name: Nitrous
pool.text: V: four seconds of rocket on loose tyres. Good luck steering.

pool.name: Leap
pool.text: Space: jump the car about six metres up.
